```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(vitae)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "English")

# Like detailed_entries(), but rows with the same org become one entry:
# - same role in every row (e.g. TA courses): one role line, then each row's
#   details as a bullet with its dates right-aligned;
# - no role (NA) in every row (e.g. awards): no role line, just the bullets
#   with their dates;
# - different roles (e.g. two degrees): the roles are stacked, each with its
#   dates and followed by its own details as a bullet.
# A single row looks the same as with detailed_entries().
grouped_entries <- function(data) {
  esc <- function(x) gsub("([&%$#_])", "\\\\\\1", x)
  bullets <- function(items) {
    if (length(items) == 0) return("")
    paste0("\\begin{cvitems}\n", paste(items, collapse = "\n"), "\n\\end{cvitems}")
  }
  dated <- function(g) sprintf("\\item %s \\hfill\\entrydatestyle{%s}", esc(g$details), g$dates)
  role_cell <- function(role, dates) {
    sprintf("\\entrypositionstyle{%s} & \\entrydatestyle{%s}", esc(role), dates)
  }
  desc_cell <- function(desc) {
    sprintf("\\multicolumn{2}{L{\\textwidth}}{\\descriptionstyle{%s}}", desc)
  }
  # Same layout as \cventry in awesome-cv.cls, but with any rows below the title;
  # like \cventry, the last row should be a description
  table_entry <- function(org, loc, rows) {
    paste0("\\setlength\\tabcolsep{0pt}\\setlength{\\extrarowheight}{0pt}%\n",
           "\\begin{tabular*}{\\textwidth}{@{\\extracolsep{\\fill}} L{\\textwidth - 4.5cm} R{4.5cm}}%\n",
           sprintf("\\entrytitlestyle{%s} & \\entrylocationstyle{%s} \\\\%%\n", esc(org), loc),
           paste(rows, collapse = " \\\\%\n"), "%\n",
           "\\end{tabular*}%")
  }
  # vitae removes the space of an empty last description line the same way
  trim <- "\n\\vspace{-4.0mm}"
  groups <- split(data, factor(data$org, levels = unique(data$org)))
  entries <- vapply(groups, function(g) {
    loc <- ifelse(is.na(g$loc[1]), "", g$loc[1])
    details <- g$details[!is.na(g$details)]
    if (nrow(g) == 1) {
      paste0(sprintf("\\cventry{%s}{%s}{%s}{%s}{%s}", esc(g$role), esc(g$org), loc,
                     g$dates, bullets(sprintf("\\item %s", esc(details)))),
             if (length(details) == 0) trim else "")
    } else if (all(is.na(g$role))) {
      table_entry(g$org[1], loc, desc_cell(bullets(dated(g))))
    } else if (length(unique(g$role)) == 1) {
      sprintf("\\cventry{%s}{%s}{%s}{}{%s}", esc(g$role[1]), esc(g$org[1]), loc,
              bullets(dated(g)))
    } else {
      rows <- unlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(g)), function(i) {
        # cvitems ends with space meant to separate entries; undo it mid-entry
        gap <- if (i < nrow(g)) "\\vspace{-2.0mm}" else ""
        c(role_cell(g$role[i], g$dates[i]),
          if (!is.na(g$details[i])) {
            desc_cell(paste0(bullets(sprintf("\\item %s", esc(g$details[i]))), gap))
          })
      }))
      if (is.na(g$details[nrow(g)])) {
        paste0(table_entry(g$org[1], loc, c(rows, desc_cell(""))), trim)
      } else {
        table_entry(g$org[1], loc, rows)
      }
    }
  }, character(1))
  knitr::asis_output(paste0("```{=latex}\n\\begin{cventries}\n",
                            paste(entries, collapse = "\n"),
                            "\n\\end{cventries}\n```\n"))
}
```
